verdict.description: well-read when nothing needs fixing; some-to-fix when at least one word was truly misread; incomplete when the transcript covers only part of target_text, or nothing clear could be heard.

focus_words.description: The words he misread, in the order they stand in the verse, each broken into chunks to say. Empty when well-read or incomplete.

word.description: The word as it stands in the verse, without punctuation.

index.description: Where this exact word stands in target_text: 0 for the first word, 1 for the second, counting the words as the scorer's word list does. Two words spelled alike have different indexes; give the one he misread.

chunks.description: The word in parts to say one after another, such as to, geth, er. Joined they spell the word.

tip.description: One short, kind line on how to say it.

say.description: Optional. How to spell the word so that a text-to-speech voice says it right when it would say the written word wrongly, such as blest for blessed. The phone speaks this, and only this, when he taps the speaker beside the word. Leave it out when the written word is spoken right.

start.description: Optional. Where this word begins in the recording, in seconds, copied from this word's start in reading_result. The phone plays just his clip of the word from here. Give it with end, or leave both out when reading_result gave no times for the word.

end.description: Optional. Where this word ends in the recording, in seconds, copied from this word's end in reading_result. Always after start. Give it with start, or leave both out.

note.description: One or two short sentences to him about the reading as a whole.
